query: Please design and rebuild a new business website, including a homepage, product pages, about us page, and contact us page. The website should have a responsive design, adapting to different devices and screen sizes. Users should be able to browse the website, view product information, submit a contact form, and navigate through the website. Apply moccasin for layout; use sandy brown for buttons and cards.
